note: Visible tests cover the empty pointer, keys, a nested key, a list index, one `~1` and one `~0` escape, a missing key and a pointer with no leading slash; only the hidden tests cover empty tokens, `~01` and one-pass decoding, bad escapes, bad and out-of-range list indexes, tokens left on a string or another scalar, and a pointer that is not a string.

twin_breaks.rule: Decoding makes one pass from left to right, so `~01` is the two characters `~1`, not `/`.

When the current value is anything else (a string, a number, a boolean or `None`) and a token is left, `TypeError` is raised. A string is never indexed: `resolve({"a": "xyz"}, "/a/0")` raises `TypeError`.
